The largest allocation is Consituency Development Planning programme with an allocation of 
K28.3 million, taking up fifty-one percent (53.3%) of the total budget allocation. These funds will 
go towards financing of capital projects within the district, paying of busaries to youths, skills 
development for women, and disaster management programmes.
Housing and Community Amenities accounts for K 6.4 million of the total budget representing 
(12%). This programme includes public amenities such as Markets & Bus Stations, Roads and 
Drainages and Street Lighting.
Management and Support Services programme has been allocated K5.7 million representing 
(11%). This programme includes Executive Office Management, Human Resource and 
Administration Management, Procurement and Internal Auditing. 
Resource Mobilisation and Management has been allocated 4.5 million representing (9%), this 
includes Revenue Mobilisation, Enhancement and Management. 
Public Health and Environmental Protection which covers Solid Waste Management, Water 
Supply & Sanitation Services, Pest Control and Health Inspection has been allocated K 3.7 
million representing (7.1%) of the total budget.
Economic and Business Development is allocated K1.3 million representing (2.5%), this 
programme includes the construction of a truck park and block making factory consisting of an 
office block.
Integrated Development Planning programme has been allocated K 1.16 million representing 
(2.2%). These funds include Spatial Planning, Social Economic and Environmental planning are 
also funded under this programme.
The allocation of K0.98 million representing (1.9%) under the Local Governance programme will 
cater for the legislative functions of the Local Authority. While the Recreation, Culture and 
Religion programme, the Public Order and Safety and the Social Protection programmes have 
been allocated K130,680, K219,471 and K356,500 respectively.
